They break the Flat Counter Rule and are recorded as drift, not as the system. Also drift from this round, recorded and not made system: the printed document's uppercase, letter-spaced labels and column heads (Ship to, Payment, Item, Size, Qty), which break the Wordmark Is the Only Spaced Caps Rule; the shadcn ghost and outline sm buttons' 0.8rem label, off the ramp; the Items card header carrying up to four ghost actions side by side; the article editor's search preview title in Google's link blue (#1a0dab), the admin's only hue.

admin.sidebarHighlight: One highlight per page: the matching sub page, else the section; never both.
admin.analytics: Share bars: 6px full-round Panel Grey track, Ink fill to the percent. Funnel bars: 10px, at least 1% when the step has any. Report tables: first column the name (500, max 18rem), every other column a right-aligned tabular figure, empty cells 'None' in Quiet Grey, CSV as a ghost sm button with Download at 1.8. Report and inbox tabs are status tabs without count chips.

narrative.overview:
Klaev is the category standard executed at Apple Store craft: a white room with a well lit counter, where one product is laid out, its price is stated once and clearly, and every choice is made in order. The system is deliberately colourless. White ground, soft grey panels and near-black ink are the whole palette; the leather photography supplies every warm tone on the screen, so nothing in the interface competes with the hide.

Density is calm and single-column on the phone (390px first). Content stacks in one column with generous 32px gaps between blocks; on wide screens the same column sits beside the photos as a sticky buy column. Form is soft and rounded: pill actions, rounded selection cards, rounded grey panels, with hairlines used to rule lists and to seat fixed chrome. Depth is flat, with exactly two pieces of frosted glass: the header and the hero's colour picker, both of which float over photography. Motion is functional only: the product photo morphs from its card into the product page, accordions slide open as their chevrons turn, the cart drawer slides in, buttons settle under the finger.

The interface earns trust with exact information rather than decoration. Money is always tabular, sizes are named by chest measurement, and payment is broken into what you send now and what you pay on delivery. The user rejected loud streetwear urgency, generic template looks, and dark, moody "leather brand" styling; the white ground is the answer to all three. The admin at /admin is the same counter seen from behind it, built in the shadcn dashboard canon the owner pinned: a Panel Grey inset sidebar holding the work as one Paper sheet, KPI cards, trend charts, data tables and tabs, all in Klaev's palette and Geist with no hue added. Its signature is the money bar, which draws every order's money as one split bar, so what came in, the cash still at the door and the courier's tax share read at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, grey panels, near-black ink; the photography is the only colour.
One typeface, Geist Sans, with large tight semibold headings and tabular numerals for money.
Black pill for the one primary action per view.
Rounded panels and selection cards; hairlines rule lists and seat fixed bars.
No shadows. Depth comes from grey panels against white; glass is reserved for the header and the hero colour picker.
Motion serves navigation and state, never ornament.
The admin is an operations console in the same materials: Panel Grey sidebar, Paper sheet, ringed cards, badges in Ink, Panel Grey and outline, one black primary per view.

rules.name: The Leather Is the Colour Rule
rules.body: The interface carries no hue. Warmth on screen comes from the product photographs alone; no brand tint, gradient or coloured badge is added. Even a colour swatch is cut from the leather photo, never painted.

rules.name: The One Grey Voice Rule
rules.body: Secondary text uses Quiet Grey and nothing else. Hierarchy below that comes from size and weight, not from more greys.

rules.name: The Red Line Rule
rules.body: Red belongs to the error line alone. An invalid field keeps its Outline Grey border and white ground; the Small Signal Red line beneath it says what to fix, and the first invalid field takes focus.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every PKR amount, size measurement and count is set with tabular numerals so columns of money align.

rules.name: The Wordmark Is the Only Spaced Caps Rule
rules.body: Wide letterspaced uppercase belongs to the KLAEV wordmark. Headings, labels and buttons stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Counter Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no hover lift, and no backdrop blur except the shared glass on the header and the hero colour picker. Everything else stays flat: if something needs to stand apart, it gets a grey panel or a hairline.

rules.name: The Hatch Means the Door Rule
rules.body: Hatching is the money bar's mark for cash the rider still has to collect, and nothing else in the system is hatched.

rules.name: The One Black Primary Rule
rules.body: Each admin view has exactly one Ink button: on an order, the Update status trigger in its header; on a form, its Save. Everything else steps down to a quiet pill, an outline button or a text link. Inside a dialog the confirming action is the one Ink button, and the menu that opened it is closed.

rules.name: The Three Fills Rule
rules.body: A badge says who holds the order by its fill alone: Ink when it waits on you, Panel Grey while it moves, outline when it is in someone else's hands or over. No badge takes a hue, and glyphs mark only Paid, Delivered, With courier, Receipt in, a refusal and a trend.

rules.name: The Not Now, Keep It Rule
rules.body: A dialog that only gathers details is dismissed with "Not now": the step waits for later. A dialog that asks before undoing (Cancel order, Refused at the door) is dismissed with "Keep it", and its confirmation says the act in full ("Yes, cancel it", "Yes, it was refused"), so the safe answer never reads like the destructive one.

rules.name: The Faint Means Estimate Rule
rules.body: In the money bar, Quiet Grey at 30% is a figure not yet known for sure; once it is recorded it turns solid.

rules.name: The Ink Is Attention Rule
rules.body: State in the admin is drawn without hue, in three tones: Ink, Panel Grey and outline. Ink is spent on a state only when it waits on the owner: an order to confirm, a receipt in, a delivery attempted, a parcel coming back, a customer who has refused a delivery (their badge, and the warning on their next order). What is moving takes Panel Grey; what is elsewhere or over takes the outline, its label in Quiet Grey once it is finished. Beyond state, Ink fills only the one primary button, the figures and the measure in a chart or bar. A label that only sorts (a message's subject) is an outline badge, not Ink.

rules.name: The Ramp Holds Rule
rules.body: Every text size is a step of the ramp: 0.6875rem (the cart count alone), 0.75, 0.875, 0.9375, 1, 1.0625, 1.125, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2, 2.25, 2.5, 3 and 3.75rem. The admin works in 0.75, 0.875, 1, 1.125, 1.25 and 1.5rem; print uses the same steps in pixels. A size between steps is drift, not a new step.

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: The sidebar marks exactly one place per page: the sub page you are on, or else, when no sub page matches, the section itself. A section and its sub page are never washed together, and the highlighted row carries aria-current="page".

rules.name: The One Menu per Row Rule
rules.body: Once a row has more than one action, every one of them goes in its single "⋯" menu; a row never shows two buttons side by side.

rules.name: The Paper Copy Rule
rules.body: A printed document is black on white with no fill, no badge, no money bar and no radius. Hierarchy comes from weight and 1px rules alone, secondary text takes one grey, sizes come from the ramp, every figure is tabular, and each order starts a new page. A slip always states, in 600, what the rider collects.

rules.name: The Grey Measure Rule
rules.body: A share or a step in the admin (where visits come from, devices, the funnel) is a full-round Ink bar on a Panel Grey track, as wide as its percent. No series takes a hue, and length alone carries the comparison.

rules.name: The No Sideways Table Rule
rules.body: A report table fits a phone by dropping its secondary columns below 640px (or 768px), never by scrolling sideways: the name and the one figure that answers the question stay, the rest come back with the room. Figures are always right-aligned and tabular, so a column of money reads down.

dos: **Do** keep the interface to Ink, Paper, the greys and Hairline; let the leather photographs carry all colour.
**Do** use the black pill for the single primary action in a view, 48px tall on phones.
**Do** set every PKR amount and measurement with tabular numerals, and show the cash-on-delivery split (advance now, balance on delivery) wherever a total is shown.
**Do** keep sold-out options visible and disabled on a Panel Grey ground, never hidden.
